nodes.title: Business Studies
nodes.description: CAPS Business Studies for Grade 12

nodes.title: Impacts of Recent Legislation
nodes.description: Skills Development Act; Labour Relations Act; Employment Equity Act; Basic Conditions of Employment Act; Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act; Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act; National Credit Act and Consumer Protection Act.

nodes.title: Skills Development Act, LRA, Employment Equity Act and BCEA
nodes.description: Skills Development Act including the role of SETAs in supporting this Act; Labour Relations Act including the rights of employers and employees according to this Act; Employment Equity Act; Basic Conditions of Employment Act including the provisions of the Act; Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act.

nodes.title: BBBEE, National Credit Act and Consumer Protection Act
nodes.description: Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act; differences between BEE and BBBEE; application of the five BBBEE pillars; National Credit Act and Consumer Protection Act including the rights of consumers in terms of these Acts.

nodes.title: Human Resources Function
nodes.description: Recruitment, selection, induction, placement, salary determination, fringe benefits/perks; implications of the LRA/BCEA/EEA/SDA on the human resources function.

nodes.title: Recruitment, Selection, Induction and Placement
nodes.description: Recruitment, selection, induction, placement.

nodes.title: Salary Determination, Benefits and Legislative Implications
nodes.description: Salary determination, fringe benefits/perks; implications of the LRA/BCEA/EEA/SDA on the human resources function.

nodes.title: Professionalism and Ethics
nodes.description: Ethical and unethical behaviour; professional and unprofessional behaviour; application of three King Code principles; types of unethical and unprofessional business practices; strategies to deal with unethical and unprofessional business practices.

nodes.title: Creative Thinking and Problem Solving
nodes.description: Problem solving and decision making; steps in problem solving; application and impact of four problem-solving techniques; application of creative thinking and advantages of creative thinking.

nodes.title: Macro-Environment: Business Strategies
nodes.description: Steps in developing a strategy; strategic management process to solve business-related problems; SWOT analysis; Porter's Five Forces model; PESTLE analysis; different types of business strategies; advantages of each business strategy; activities; steps in strategy evaluation.

nodes.title: Strategic Management Process and SWOT Analysis
nodes.description: Steps in developing a strategy; strategic management process to solve business-related problems; application of the industrial analysis tools: SWOT analysis.

nodes.title: Porter's Five Forces, PESTLE and Business Strategy Types
nodes.description: Application of industrial analysis tools: Porter's Five Forces model and PESTLE analysis; different types of business strategies to address business challenges; advantages of each type of business strategy; activities; steps in strategy evaluation.

nodes.title: Business Sectors and Their Environments
nodes.description: Three types of business sectors; classification of challenges according to the three business environments.

nodes.title: Quality of Performance
nodes.description: Quality concepts and differences; benefits of a good quality management system; contribution of quality of performance to the success and/or failure of each business function; quality indicators of each business function; meaning of TQM; impact of five TQM elements; importance of quality circles; PDCA model; impact of poor TQM implementation; ways TQM can reduce cost of quality.

nodes.title: Quality Concepts and Business Function Quality Indicators
nodes.description: Quality concepts and differences; benefits of a good quality management system; contribution of quality of performance to the success and/or failure of each business function; quality indicators of each business function.

nodes.title: Total Quality Management (TQM)
nodes.description: Meaning of TQM; impact of five TQM elements on large businesses; importance of quality circles; application of a PDCA model; impact of TQM if poorly implemented by businesses; ways in which TQM can reduce the cost of quality.

nodes.title: Management and Leadership
nodes.description: Differences between management and leadership; application of five leadership styles; impact of democratic, autocratic, laissez-faire/free reign, charismatic and transactional leadership styles; leadership theories; role of personal attitude in success and leadership.

nodes.title: Differences Between Management and Leadership and Leadership Styles
nodes.description: Differences between management and leadership; application of five leadership styles; impact of democratic and autocratic leadership styles.

nodes.title: Leadership Theories and Personal Attitude
nodes.description: Impact of laissez-faire/free reign, charismatic and transactional leadership styles; leadership theories; role of personal attitude in success and leadership.

nodes.title: Investment: Securities
nodes.description: Functions of the JSE; investment decisions factors; types of investment opportunities and risk factors; impact of four forms of investment; types of preference shares; differences between ordinary and preference shares; four investment concepts; differences between simple and compound interest; calculations of simple and compound interest; recommend types/forms of investment based on calculations.

nodes.title: JSE, Investment Types and Shares
nodes.description: Functions of the JSE; investment decisions factors; types of investment opportunities and risk factors of each; impact of the four forms of investment; types of preference shares; differences between ordinary and preference shares.

nodes.title: Investment Concepts and Interest Calculations
nodes.description: Meaning of four investment concepts; differences between simple and compound interest; calculations of simple and compound interest; recommend types/forms of investment based on the calculations.

nodes.title: Investment: Insurance
nodes.description: Non-compulsory and compulsory insurance; meaning of four insurance concepts; insurable and non-insurable risk; four principles of insurance; calculations of the average clause; advantages of insurance for businesses; types of compulsory insurance; types of benefits paid by the UIF; differences between compulsory and non-compulsory insurance.

nodes.title: Non-Compulsory Insurance
nodes.description: Meaning of non-compulsory insurance; meaning of four insurance concepts, differences and examples; insurable and non-insurable risk; four principles of insurance; calculations of the average clause; advantages of insurance for businesses.

nodes.title: Compulsory Insurance
nodes.description: Meaning of compulsory insurance; types of compulsory insurance; types of benefits paid by the UIF; differences between compulsory and non-compulsory insurance.

nodes.title: Team Performance and Conflict Management
nodes.description: Four criteria and characteristics for successful teams; five stages of team development; importance of team dynamics theories; causes of conflict; conflict resolution techniques/steps; dealing with grievances and difficult people; differences between grievance and conflict; dealing with six types of difficult personalities; dealing with difficult employees in the workplace.

nodes.title: Team Performance Assessment
nodes.description: Four criteria and characteristics for successful teams; five stages of team development; importance of team dynamics theories.

nodes.title: Conflict Resolution and Difficult People
nodes.description: Causes of conflict; conflict resolution techniques/steps; dealing with grievances and difficult people; differences between grievance and conflict; dealing with six types of difficult personalities; dealing with difficult employees in the workplace.

nodes.title: Human Rights, Inclusivity and Environmental Issues
nodes.description: Six human rights in the workplace; economic and social rights of employees; cultural rights in the workplace; diversity (meaning, seven diversity issues, benefits); environmental factors; responsibilities of employers and employees in promoting health and safety; roles of health and safety representatives; strategies to protect the environment and human health.

nodes.title: Human Rights and Diversity in the Workplace
nodes.description: Dealing with six human rights in the workplace; economic rights of employees in the workplace; social rights of employees in the workplace and how they can be promoted; dealing with cultural rights in the workplace; meaning of diversity; dealing with seven diversity issues in the workplace; benefits of diversity in the workplace.

nodes.title: Environmental Factors and Health and Safety
nodes.description: Environmental factors; responsibilities of employers and employees in promoting human health and safety in the workplace; roles of the health and safety representatives in protecting the workplace environment; strategies businesses may use to protect the environment and human health.

nodes.title: Social Responsibility
nodes.description: Meaning of social responsibility; relationship/link between social responsibility and triple bottom line; ways in which a business project can contribute towards the community; identification of three socio-economic issues; ways businesses can deal with socio-economic issues; ways businesses can contribute to improving the well-being of employees and communities.

nodes.title: Corporate Social Responsibility and Corporate Social Investment
nodes.description: CSR: meaning, purpose, components, impact on businesses and communities. CSI: meaning, purpose, focus areas, differences between CSR and CSI, impact on businesses and communities.

nodes.title: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)
nodes.description: Meaning of CSR; purpose of CSR; components of CSR; impact of CSR on businesses and communities.

nodes.title: Corporate Social Investment (CSI)
nodes.description: Meaning of CSI; purpose of CSI; CSI focus areas; differences between CSR and CSI; impact of CSI on businesses and communities.

nodes.title: Presentation and Data Response
nodes.description: Factors that must be considered before, during and after the presentation; responding to questions after a presentation in a non-aggressive and professional manner; areas of improvement; designing a multimedia presentation; examples of non-verbal presentations; impact/effectiveness of each visual aid.

nodes.title: Presentation Skills
nodes.description: Factors that must be considered before, during and after the presentation; responding to questions after a presentation in a non-aggressive and professional manner; areas of improvement in the next presentation.

nodes.title: Data Response and Visual Aids
nodes.description: Designing a multimedia presentation; examples of non-verbal presentations; impact/effectiveness of each visual aid.

nodes.title: Forms of Ownership
nodes.description: Characteristics of each form of ownership; meaning of limited liability and unlimited liability; impact of the different forms of ownership; how the six criteria could contribute to the success and/or failure of each form of ownership.

nodes.title: Characteristics and Liability
nodes.description: Characteristics of each form of ownership; meaning of limited liability and unlimited liability; impact of the different forms of ownership.

nodes.title: Six Criteria and Success or Failure of Forms of Ownership
nodes.description: How the six criteria could contribute to the success and/or failure of each form of ownership.
